messages.text: BL-1652 🎵 in progress — The chase sweep never respawns a role whose own pane shows the busy footer or whose worktree lane is running, respawns a role at most once per sweep however many stuck inbox items it holds, and logs each respawn with the readings it was decided on - on 2026-09-19 it respawned QA seven times in one tick at 04:01:31Z (liveness dead on a stale heartbeat, five inbox items past their chase ceiling) in the middle of an 80-minute land, then again at 04:07:10Z
